in_sanskrit.name: Kreethi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kreethi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Kreethi is derived from the Sanskrit language and is the name of a goddess associated with wealth and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as holding a lotus or a bowl of rice, symbolizing abundance and fertility. The name is also believed to bring good fortune and financial success.
